text:
Alex: FYI opened a PR to align the export playbook with the structured audit-event schema + add runnable SDK snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/578
Maria: Great. We need to be careful with retention language. Legal prefers 'default retention period (e.g., 90 days)' phrasing instead of absolute statements.
Alex: Updated draft to 'default retention period (for example, 90 days) unless overridden by contract or law'.
Jordan: We should include minimal curl + Node streaming example and show pagination for large exports. I left a sample in the PR comments.
Sam: I'll add a Go SDK snippet and a tiny CLI example that demonstrates `--redact` flag.
Maria: Include both streaming and batch examples in the main flow; put longer variants under "More examples".
Alex: Agreed. Jordan, can you add the streaming snippet? Sam will add the CLI and Go.
Jordan: Added streaming pseudo-code:
```
// node streaming export
const stream = await client.exports.stream({tenant: 'acme', since: '2026-01-01', redact: true});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  handle(chunk);
}
```
Sam: Pushed Go example and CLI in commit d1a2b3. CLI shows pagination: `redwood export --tenant=acme --page-size=1000 --include-pii=false`.
Maria: Legal, can you review the sentence: "Default retention periods are guidance; enforceable retention is determined by customer contract, compliance needs, and applicable laws, and can be overridden per-customer on Dedicated/Private deployments."?
Legal: LGTM. Tiny edit: add a comma after 'laws'. Also note we should avoid promising redaction for every export - use 'tools for redaction/pseudonymization' wording.
Alex: Adjusted wording and added a short pseudonymization helper:
```
function pseudonymize(rec) { return {...rec, user_id: hash(rec.user_id)} }
```
Jordan: Also changed the JSON example to avoid showing raw user_id; show `user_ref` as pseudonymized.
docs-bot: link-checker: broken link found in docs/export-playbook.md -> https://old.company.internal/export-guidelines (404)
Sam: Replaced with https://docs.redwood.com/export-playbook#guidelines and pushed fix.
Maria: Tone nit: keep main examples compact. Put expanded code blocks under "Appendix: Extended examples".
Alex: Done. PR now includes: retention phrasing updated, Node streaming snippet, Go SDK snippet, CLI pagination example, pseudonymization helper, and link fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/578
Jordan: I'll approve once the streaming block has a language marker (```js).
Legal: Approved with small punctuation suggestion applied.
Alex: Merged to main after docs CI passed. Closing thread.
Sam: :shipit: 
Maria: :white_check_mark: 
docs-bot: deploy-notice: docs.main updated (build 1223) - all checks green
